name: How long does a new roof installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a new roof installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a new roof installation varies based on several factors, including the size and complexity of your roof, the chosen material, and weather conditions. For an average-sized home with asphalt shingles, installation typically takes 2 to 5 days. More complex roofs or specialized materials like tile or metal may extend the project to a week or more. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption while ensuring quality and safety.
